name: js_free_rt

ownership.argument: Recorded because the string and cstring compositions allocate through the realloc slot, so a failure path may need the matching free on this build. The module's own release path for JS values remains qjs_free_value.

provenance.source: Same shape as the realloc wrapper but reads slot +4 of the hook table: R0 = *(rt+0x10); R3 = *(R0+4); R0 += 0x10; BLX R3 with r1 passed through, i.e. the free slot called as (hook_ctx, ptr).

notes: Recorded because the string and cstring compositions allocate through the realloc slot, so a failure path may need the matching free on this build. The module's own release path for JS values remains qjs_free_value.
